questions.explanation: 前文提到烹饪一直是我的一个小乐趣（small enjoyment），因此十年前我在从头制作美食中找到了巨大的“快乐（joy）”。易错点：A项loss（失落）与文意相反；D项trouble（麻烦）不符合享受烹饪的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(loss)：语境句：The company suffered a great loss last year. 固定搭配：a loss of, at a loss
B(joy)：语境句：She wept for joy when she heard the good news. 固定搭配：find joy in, to one's joy
C(courage)：语境句：It takes courage to stand up for what you believe in. 固定搭配：muster courage, lose courage
D(trouble)：语境句：He got into trouble for being late again. 固定搭配：have trouble doing, in trouble

questions.explanation: 由后文“including a few unfortunate cuts（包括几次不幸的割伤）”可知，这里指的是发生了一系列“意外事故（accidents）”。
questions.supplement:
A(choices)：语境句：We have a wide range of choices for breakfast. 固定搭配：make a choice, have no choice but to
B(treatments)：语境句：The hospital provides various treatments for patients. 固定搭配：medical treatment, undergo treatment
C(accidents)：语境句：He was badly injured in a car accident. 固定搭配：by accident, traffic accident
D(questions)：语境句：Feel free to ask questions if you are confused. 固定搭配：ask a question, out of the question

questions.explanation: 因为经历了切到手等一系列意外，所以作者对做饭变得“犹豫、害怕（hesitant）”。易错点：B项excited（兴奋）和D项ready（准备好）与受伤后的心理不符。
questions.supplement:
A(hesitant)：语境句：She was hesitant to accept the job offer in a new city. 固定搭配：be hesitant to do, hesitant about
B(excited)：语境句：The kids were excited about the upcoming field trip. 固定搭配：be excited about, get excited
C(curious)：语境句：Children are naturally curious about the world around them. 固定搭配：be curious about, out of curiosity
D(ready)：语境句：Are you ready to order your meal? 固定搭配：be ready for, get ready to

questions.explanation: 后文提到“relying more on my husband to cook or takeout（更多地依靠丈夫做饭或点外卖）”，说明作者渐渐远离了“做饭（cooking）”。
questions.supplement:
A(cleaning)：语境句：She spends her weekends cleaning the house. 固定搭配：do the cleaning, dry cleaning
B(cooking)：语境句：My mother's cooking is always the best. 固定搭配：do the cooking, home cooking
C(hospitals)：语境句：Many hospitals are under severe pressure during the flu season. 固定搭配：go to hospital, in hospital
D(restaurants)：语境句：We decided to eat out at a local restaurant. 固定搭配：book a restaurant, fast-food restaurant

questions.explanation: 句首有However表转折，说明作者现在决定“重新发现（rediscover）”对烹饪的热爱。易错点：C项forget（忘记）逻辑相反；A项convey（传达）不符合自我内心的转变。
questions.supplement:
A(convey)：语境句：Words cannot convey how grateful I am for your help. 固定搭配：convey information, convey one's feelings
B(test)：语境句：The teacher will test the students on their vocabulary. 固定搭配：take a test, stand the test of time
C(forget)：语境句：Don't forget to lock the door when you leave. 固定搭配：forget about, forget to do
D(rediscover)：语境句：He traveled to the countryside to rediscover his inner peace. 固定搭配：rediscover oneself, rediscover the joy of

questions.explanation: 前文提到了手上的伤（cuts），所以重回厨房时会害怕再次“弄伤（injuring）”自己。
questions.supplement:
A(injuring)：语境句：He missed the match for fear of injuring his ankle again. 固定搭配：injure oneself, badly injured
B(excusing)：语境句：There is no excusing such rude behavior. 固定搭配：excuse sb for doing, make an excuse
C(blaming)：语境句：She is always blaming others for her own mistakes. 固定搭配：blame sb for sth, take the blame
D(changing)：语境句：The weather here is constantly changing. 固定搭配：change one's mind, changing room

questions.explanation: “cost of living”是固定表达，意为“生活成本”。随着生活成本的不断上升，只依赖餐馆不再具有可持续性。
questions.supplement:
A(level)：语境句：The water level in the river rose dangerously high. 固定搭配：sea level, high level
B(value)：语境句：This ancient coin is of great historic value. 固定搭配：core value, of great value
C(quality)：语境句：We aim to provide high quality products to our customers. 固定搭配：high quality, quality of life
D(cost)：语境句：The cost of living in big cities is quite high. 固定搭配：cost of living, at all costs

questions.explanation: 尽管内心有恐惧，但基于生活成本的现实，作者带着“决心（determination）”重新走进了厨房。
questions.supplement:
A(energy)：语境句：Running a marathon requires a lot of energy. 固定搭配：save energy, full of energy
B(dream)：语境句：Her dream is to become a famous singer. 固定搭配：achieve a dream, dream of doing
C(determination)：语境句：He overcame his disability with sheer determination. 固定搭配：with determination, strong determination
D(pleasure)：语境句：It is a great pleasure to work with you. 固定搭配：with pleasure, my pleasure

questions.explanation: 后文提到了具体的菜品红酒炖牛肉（Beef Bourguignon），这是一份“食谱（recipe）”。
questions.supplement:
A(gift)：语境句：She has a special gift for learning languages quickly. 固定搭配：birthday gift, have a gift for
B(recipe)：语境句：My grandma passed down this secret recipe to me. 固定搭配：secret recipe, a recipe for disaster
C(idea)：语境句：It is a good idea to bring an umbrella just in case. 固定搭配：have no idea, come up with an idea
D(advertisement)：语境句：I saw an advertisement for a new smartphone on TV. 固定搭配：place an advertisement, job advertisement

questions.explanation: 虽然早就爱上了做饭，但以前从未“尝试（attempted）”过这道经典的法国菜。
questions.supplement:
A(sold)：语境句：The tickets for the concert were completely sold out. 固定搭配：sell out, best-selling
B(mentioned)：语境句：He mentioned that he would be late for the meeting. 固定搭配：not to mention, as mentioned above
C(attempted)：语境句：He attempted to swim across the English Channel. 固定搭配：attempt to do, make an attempt
D(accepted)：语境句：She finally accepted his apology and forgave him. 固定搭配：accept an offer, widely accepted

questions.explanation: “a labor of love”是英语常见习语，指“心甘情愿做的事（尤指不计报酬、出于爱好而做的艰苦工作）”。制作这道菜需要大量时间精力，但出于热爱所以值得。
questions.supplement:
A(labor)：语境句：Restoring this antique car was truly a labor of love. 固定搭配：manual labor, a labor of love
B(rule)：语境句：You must follow the rules of the game. 固定搭配：break the rule, as a rule
C(mark)：语境句：The incident left a permanent mark on his memory. 固定搭配：leave a mark, hit the mark
D(promise)：语境句：She made a promise to visit her grandparents every week. 固定搭配：keep a promise, make a promise

questions.explanation: 做这道菜需要时间、细节上的关注以及“耐心（patience）”。
questions.supplement:
A(space)：语境句：We need more storage space in the kitchen. 固定搭配：outer space, empty space
B(belief)：语境句：It is her firm belief that hard work pays off. 固定搭配：beyond belief, hold a belief
C(caution)：语境句：You should exercise caution when crossing the busy street. 固定搭配：with caution, exercise caution
D(patience)：语境句：Teaching young children requires a great deal of patience. 固定搭配：have patience with, lose patience

questions.explanation: 从给牛肉调味到与红酒混合，烹饪过程中的每一个“步骤（step）”都是对风味与技巧的庆祝。
questions.supplement:
A(dish)：语境句：This vegetarian dish is made with fresh ingredients. 固定搭配：wash the dishes, a popular dish
B(event)：语境句：The Olympic Games is a major international sporting event. 固定搭配：in the event of, at all events
C(step)：语境句：Taking this course is the first step towards your career. 固定搭配：step by step, take steps
D(secret)：语境句：She kept her plans a secret from her family. 固定搭配：keep a secret, in secret

questions.explanation: 第一次成功做出这样复杂的菜，给作者带来了一种“成就感（sense of accomplishment）”。
questions.supplement:
A(relief)：语境句：It was a great relief to know that everyone was safe. 固定搭配：sigh of relief, to one's relief
B(accomplishment)：语境句：Winning the championship gave him a huge sense of accomplishment. 固定搭配：sense of accomplishment, remarkable accomplishment
C(warmth)：语境句：He felt the warmth of the sun on his face. 固定搭配：feel the warmth, provide warmth
D(responsibility)：语境句：It is your responsibility to complete the task on time. 固定搭配：take responsibility for, sense of responsibility

questions.explanation: 做饭不一定非得是某种“负担（burden）”，它可以是一种自我表达的方式。与文章开头所逃避做饭的负面情绪形成对比呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(burden)：语境句：The heavy debt became a huge burden on the poor family. 固定搭配：a heavy burden, shoulder the burden
B(surprise)：语境句：His sudden resignation took everyone by surprise. 固定搭配：to one's surprise, take sb by surprise
C(regret)：语境句：I have no regrets about the choices I have made. 固定搭配：express regret, with regret
D(danger)：语境句：The abandoned building is in danger of collapsing. 固定搭配：in danger, out of danger

section_2_word_form.passage:
The term "Xuan paper" first appeared in On Famous Paintings Through the Ages, a book written by Tang Dynasty scholar Zhang Yanyuan, [56] he described Xuan paper as an ideal carrier for calligraphy and painting. Handmade Xuan paper from Jingxian county, East China's Anhui province, [57] as a gift to the imperial court then for its supreme quality.
During the Qing Dynasty Xuan paper reached its peak of [58] and quality. The traditional craft (工艺) of making Xuan paper is extremely [59] . The bark of sandalwood, a plant native to southern China, [60] through 108 procedures over the course of three years before it can transform into fine Xuan paper.
The flow of ink determines the output of Chinese art, and Xuan paper outshines others with its excellent ability [61] full play to ink. Different proportions (比例) of bark to straw during the paper-making process can create different canvases (画布) best suited [62] artistic expression in freehand ink paintings or calligraphy. The unique quality of Xuan paper is [63] valued in the world of Chinese calligraphy and painting.
Xuan paper is very resistant to the damage brought by time. It is this durability [64] has made the preservation of many valuable works from ancient China possible. The long history, unique craftsmanship, and high quality of Xuan paper have made it a [65] cultural heritage of China.

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构可知，逗号后是非限制性定语从句，先行词是 a book。从句完整不缺主宾，且在从句中作地点/方位状语（in the book），故用关系副词where（也可填in which，但设空为一词优先where）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(where)：语境句：This is the exact spot where the accident happened. 固定搭配：where to go, point where。其它用法：可作连词引导地点状语从句。

questions.explanation: 句意：手工宣纸在当时因其极高的品质“被列为”皇家贡品。主语 Xuan paper 与 list 之间是动宾关系，且时间状语 then 表明是过去的事，故填一般过去时的被动语态。
knowledge_points: 一般过去时的被动语态
questions.supplement: 正确形(was listed)：语境句：The building was listed as a national heritage site last year. 固定搭配：be listed as, list out。原词list其它变形：unlisted(adj.), listing(n.)。

questions.explanation: 介词 of 后应接名词，且由 and 可知需要与名词 quality 并列，popular 的名词形式是 popularity（受欢迎度/普及）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(popularity)：语境句：The band has gained huge popularity among teenagers. 固定搭配：gain popularity, popularity contest。原词popular其它变形：popularize(v.), popularly(adv.)。

questions.explanation: 系动词 is 后需接形容词作表语。demand意为“要求”，其形容词 demanding 意为“要求高的，费力的”，符合修饰传统工艺（craft）极难的语境。
questions.supplement: 正确形(demanding)：语境句：She has a very demanding schedule this week. 固定搭配：highly demanding, a demanding job。原词demand其它变形：demand(n./v.), undemanding(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 句意：檀树皮要“经历”108道工序。陈述工艺流程的一般事实，用一般现在时。主语 The bark 是不可数名词，谓语动词用第三人称单数goes。go through 为固定短语，意为“经历”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(goes)：语境句：The country goes through severe economic challenges. 固定搭配：go through, go ahead。原词go其它变形：went(v.过去式), gone(v.过去分词)。

questions.explanation: 名词 ability 后常跟动词不定式作后置定语，即 ability to do sth.。give full play to 意为“充分发挥”。
knowledge_points: 动词不定式作后置定语
questions.supplement: 正确形(to give)：语境句：She has the ability to give clear and concise explanations. 固定搭配：ability to do, give full play to。原词give其它变形：gave(v.过去式), given(v.过去分词)。

questions.explanation: 固定搭配 be suited for/to 意为“适合于...”，此处 suited 为过去分词作后置定语，修饰 canvases，应填介词 for 或 to。
questions.supplement: 正确形(for / to)：语境句：This mild climate is perfectly suited for growing grapes. 固定搭配：be suited for, be suited to。

questions.explanation: 空处修饰后面的动词（过去分词）valued，需用副词形式。high 的副词 highly 意为“高度地，极度地”，highly valued 即“被高度重视/评价”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(highly)：语境句：Her creative designs are highly valued by the fashion industry. 固定搭配：highly valued, speak highly of。原词high其它变形：highness(n.), higher(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 考查强调句型。句子结构为 It is + 被强调部分 + that/who ...。本句强调的是主语 this durability（正是这种耐久性），且为事物，故用 that。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that)：语境句：It is his courage that makes him a true hero. 固定搭配：It is... that..., so... that...。其它用法：指代词、从句引导词等。

questions.explanation: 空处修饰名词短语 cultural heritage（文化遗产），需要形容词。treasure的过去分词 treasured 已形容词化，意为“珍贵的，受珍视的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(treasured)：语境句：These letters are among my most treasured possessions. 固定搭配：treasured memory, national treasure。原词treasure其它变形：treasure(n./v.), treasury(n.), treasurer(n.)。
